title: Refuse incomplete configured root coverage after Cargo discovery loss for SpecSync 6.1.1
description: Refuse incomplete configured root coverage after Cargo discovery loss for SpecSync 6.1.1
acceptance_criteria: Coverage and check must never report a complete partial inventory when an eligible selected regular root source file loses checked Cargo exact-target authority, including a previously inferred selection whose manifest disappears between discovery phases. Valid checked Cargo files retain existing coverage; malformed, missing or changed manifests with an unrecognized eligible selected regular root file fail inconclusive instead of omitting it. Explicit directory-only fallback, extension/test/exclusion filtering, no-follow confinement, exact-file boundaries and existing input budgets remain intact. Preserve the reproduced nonempty50-to-false100 before case, prove corrected text/JSON controls and pass independent review and final pinned local verification before genuine acceptance and release gates.

answers.constraints: Restore existing REQ-validator-044 checked-Cargo-only exact-source authority and fail-closed retained coverage; preserve REQ-validator-008 directory-only configured fallback. Do not admit arbitrary configured files, widen a file selection to its parent, add dependencies/options or weaken no-follow identity/budgets. Keep old archived human acceptances and current follow-up scope approval untouched. This package is a draft, with no human definition or implementation approval yet claimed.
